steps.title: Web service - Domains and TLS
steps.subtitle: Match your public hostname to ntfy's base-url.

steps.title: Web service - Upstream and WebSockets
steps.subtitle: Subscriptions use the same upstream port, including the WebSocket.

steps.title: HTTP - Publishing and attachments
steps.subtitle: Allow the methods ntfy clients use and match the attachment size limit.

steps.title: HTTP - Request limits
steps.subtitle: Let bursts to one topic reach ntfy's own limit of 60, and let each open topic hold a connection.

steps.title: HTTP - Error responses
steps.subtitle: Pass ntfy's own JSON errors to its apps and CLI instead of BunkerWeb's error page.

steps.title: Security - Metrics endpoint
steps.subtitle: Keep Prometheus /metrics private. If you scrape it through BunkerWeb, clear the field.

steps.title: Security - Review CRS exclusions
steps.subtitle: Narrow exclusions for raw bodies, message text, passwords and webhook JSON.
